cards.text: This psalm doesn't name its writer, but it opens with "The LORD reigns" as an announcement to the whole world. THREE WORDS, friend, the shortest headline in history, and it STILL covers everybody on the planet. And the very next line tells the nations how to take it.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD reigns, so the psalm tells the nations to sit back and relax.

cards.text: He's enthroned above the cherubim, and the psalm says, "let the earth quake!" Friend, back when I lived in the back of a junk drawer, my biggest earthquake was somebody rattling it open looking for TAPE.

cards.question: The psalm says the LORD is great in Zion, also called Mount Zion (Psalm 48:2). Who does it say He is exalted above?

cards.text: But shaking isn't the whole response. The psalm calls for praise too, "Let them praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy!" and then it says, "The mighty King loves justice."

cards.question: True or false: The psalm says the mighty King loves justice but hasn't acted on it yet.

cards.text: He has established equity and exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob, here meaning Israel, the nation that came from Jacob (Genesis 35:10-11). Then the call goes out: "Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!"

cards.question: Now the psalm reaches back into Israel's history. Which two men does it name among the LORD's priests?

cards.text: That's Moses, Israel's leader, and his brother Aaron (Exodus 4:14). Then one more name: Samuel, a prophet who anointed Saul and David (1 Samuel 10:1; 16:13), among those who called on His name.

cards.question: True or false: When Moses, Aaron and Samuel called to the LORD, the psalm says He answered.

cards.text: Then the psalm says He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud, and He gave them decrees and statutes. Friend, my oven timer dings and I jump a foot, gold base and all, so a voice from a PILLAR OF CLOUD would send me face-first into the chocolate chips.

cards.question: The psalm says the LORD gave Moses, Aaron and Samuel His decrees and statutes, and they ___ them.
The psalm talks right to God about Moses, Aaron and Samuel. How does it describe Him toward them?

answers.text: Forgiving yet an avenger of their misdeeds
Forgiving so He overlooked their misdeeds
Strict so He never forgave their misdeeds

cards.text: One last call to exalt the LORD our God. Earlier it was worship at His footstool, but this time the place is different.

cards.question: The psalm said the LORD is great in Zion. Now its last call is to worship at the LORD's holy ___.

cards.text: And the very last words: "for the LORD our God is holy." That's the third time this psalm says He's holy, friend, and every single one had me standing up straighter on my gold base.
